title: plagiobothrys hispidus var. foliaceus
intro: Plagiobothrys hispidus var. foliaceus, commonly known as Western poppy or California popcorn flower, is a flowering plant in the borage family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Plagiobothrys hispidus var. foliaceus include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
